versions.content: ExecutionTime . includedLibrary The Execution- Time measurements can depend on the precise version of external libraries (such as a math-emulation library) that have been used. This information can be included by adding a reference to an object of type DependencyOnArtifact which shall be aggregated by the corresponding Implementation . If such a reference is specified, the ExecutionTime includes the execution time of that specific library version. In case the Implementation aggregates attributes of type DependencyOnArti- fact , to which the ExecutionTime does not refer, it means that the execution time of the library code is NOT included in the execution time of the ExecutableEntity .
